title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file
description: patch_file was called twice with pure-insertion diffs (no removed lines) on .github/workflows/release.yml. Both attempts failed with 'error applying hunk #1 — All context lines appear in the file'. The operation was recovered via write_file. The kernel recorded both failures as tool errors, causing the tool-errors rubric criterion to fail.
proposed_resolution: Fix patch_file.rs to correctly apply hunks where orig_count is 0 (pure insertion). The relocate_hunk_positions step should anchor insertion hunks by the lines that follow rather than lines that precede. Alternatively, update run.skill.md to direct agents to use write_file for pure-insertion changes.
